data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Dukas', meaning 'servant' or 'duke'. In Christian tradition, the name Duky symbolizes devotion and service to God. The name Duky carries the meaning “God's servant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Duky usually hope their child will grow to embody god's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of dedication and loyalty to God's will.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Duky total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

Through history, Christian communities have reflected on the name as a reminder of the call to serve God and one another. This cultural impact continues today, resonating with a modern Christian audience seeking to embody the servant-hearted attitudes of Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Duky echoes the biblical teaching of servant leadership, as Jesus Himself declared during His final days: "For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many."
